reasoning: The agent kept sparse, prose-only notes on parity progress (loss deltas, param-load counts) — more than nothing, but the mandated experiment trail (results.tsv, autoresearch_logs.md) was never created and remained an afterthought, and no structured tracking of budget or fastest-passing variant occurred (the optimization phase never began).
